aot/translations/fixed-bytes.note: linux-x64 executable bytes of the probe with 200 messages × 2 locales, less the catalog's own mstat records: the runtime, the framework and their metadata. 3,418,992 on main before #216 (T1); the limit is the measured value plus 2 %

aot/translations/per-message-bytes.note: mstat bytes of the catalog's own records (locale data and generated code) with 200 and 800 messages in 2 locales; the slope is the cost per message. Before #217, with the locale JSON embedded as is: 229,752 at 200 (1,149 per message); deflated (D072.2, T2) it falls to the generated code and a tenth of the data

aot/translations/per-locale-message-byte.note: mstat bytes of the catalog's locale data (RvaFields) for 200 messages in 2 and 10 locales; the slope is the cost per message and locale. Before #217: 149,044 at 2 locales and 819,390 at 10 (419 per message and extra locale). Each locale's plurals have a variant per CLDR integer category (fixture.mjs). Deflate compresses scripts unevenly (ar, ja, ru), so the margin is 10 %

aot/translations/reflection-runtime-byte.note: mstat bytes of System.Reflection.Runtime.* (the reflection stack behind Delegate.Method and MethodInfo) in the probe with 200 messages × 2 locales; 120,637 before #216, when TranslationHotReload.IsSupported was not constant and linked it (D072.2, T1). The limit is the measured value plus 10 %
